caption:
Google turned off a feature on your Business Profile, and most owners haven't noticed.

The Q&A API went dark on November 3, 2025. The public Q&A section started phasing out on December 3, 2025.

Google's AI now writes those answers instead, pulling from your categories, services, attributes, hours, photos, and reviews.

Thin fields and inconsistent reviews mean it guesses, or skips you for a sharper competitor.

Do this before Friday:

1. Write a full description for every service category, not a one-line label
2. Rewrite your business description to name your service area and specialty
3. Get your next 3 completed jobs reviewed, with the actual service named

Reviews are one of six inputs the AI reads. The platform automates the ask after every job.

DM TRIAL

#LocalSEO #GoogleBusinessProfile #ServiceBusinessMarketing #HomeServices #SmallBusinessTips
rationale: Interprets a genuinely current GBP platform change (Q&A retirement, AI-sourced answers) into a concrete profile-and-review fix, bridging to the platform's verified review-collection feature.
